sql: SELECT run_fondo, nombre_fondo, round(valor_miles_mf / 1e3, 1) AS patrimonio_mm FROM fi_balance WHERE contexto = 'PeriodoActual' AND codigo_cuenta = 'TotalPatrimonioNeto' AND moneda = 'CLP' AND periodo = (SELECT max(periodo) FROM fi_balance) ORDER BY valor_miles_mf DESC LIMIT 20;
